summary: HA Sustainable Infrastructure Capital filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for $500 million of 7.850% Green Junior Subordinated Notes due 2057. Interest is fixed at 7.850% through the June 1, 2032 first reset date, then resets to the five-year U.S. Treasury rate plus 316.4 bp, subject to a 7.850% floor. Notes mature June 1, 2057, pay semi-annually from June 1, 2027, and are redeemable at par within 90 days of the first reset date and on later interest dates. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
